## Is Your Feature Request Related to a Problem?

A clear and concise description of what the problem is.
Example: "I'm always frustrated when I have to create a maintainer checklist from scratch..."

## Describe the Solution You'd Like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Describe Alternatives You've Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Proposed Location

Where should this new resource live?

- [ ] `docs/` — new guide
- [ ] `templates/` — new template
- [ ] `.github/` — new GitHub template
- [ ] `README.md` — new section
- [ ] Other: ___________

## Willing to Contribute?

- [ ] Yes, I can submit a PR for this
- [ ] Yes, I can help review
- [ ] No, just suggesting

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.

## Drips Wave Relevance

If this feature would help maintainers participate in Drips Wave, explain how.
